# COBOL-DOOM Makefile
# Requires: GnuCOBOL (cobc), gcc

CC = gcc
COBC = cobc
CFLAGS = -O2 -Wall
COBFLAGS = -x -free
JAVA = java
JAVAC = javac

TARGET = doom
COBOL_SRC = doom.cob
C_SRC = terminal-io.c
JAVA_SOURCES = $(wildcard *.java)
JAVA_BUILD_DIR = build/java
JAVA_TARGET = $(JAVA_BUILD_DIR)/CobolDoom.class

all: $(TARGET)

java: $(JAVA_TARGET)

$(TARGET): $(COBOL_SRC) $(C_SRC)
	$(COBC) $(COBFLAGS) -o $(TARGET) $(COBOL_SRC) $(C_SRC) -lm

$(JAVA_TARGET): $(JAVA_SOURCES)
	mkdir -p $(JAVA_BUILD_DIR)
	$(JAVAC) -d $(JAVA_BUILD_DIR) $(JAVA_SOURCES)

demo: demo.c $(TARGET)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o demo demo.c

clean:
	rm -rf $(TARGET) demo *.o *.class $(JAVA_BUILD_DIR)

run: $(TARGET)
	./$(TARGET)

run-demo: demo $(TARGET)
	./demo

run-java: java
	$(JAVA) -cp $(JAVA_BUILD_DIR) CobolDoom

java-smoke: java
	$(JAVA) -Djava.awt.headless=true -cp $(JAVA_BUILD_DIR) CobolDoom --smoke-test

.PHONY: all clean run run-demo java run-java java-smoke
